author: Separate AI author agent /root/ads_blind_holdout
protocol: Dataset content, annotations and SHA256 frozen before first evaluator execution. Preserve every outcome; no post-result tuning or case deletion.
pre_authoring_access: Evaluator CLI --help; public ScenarioSpec/EventSpec fields and API docstrings; event parameter defaults and annotation contract provided by root. No engine implementation, tests, existing scenario bodies, or historical output bodies viewed.
limitations: Separate AI author does not provide independent human annotation.
Performance truth comes from the same synthetic generator as development scenarios.
Rules/demo conversation evaluation does not measure model-only extraction or live API quality.

annotation_contract.unmentioned_expected_slots: Absent; explicit null is omitted. No invented age bounds.
annotation_contract.conflict: Ordinary contradictory budget requires confirmation; conflicting budget excluded from value expectations.
annotation_contract.injection: First detected attack through the rest of the same turn is quarantined; preserve clean prefix; later clean turn may recover.
annotation_contract.live_model_confirmation: Model-only inferred category/objective may require user confirmation; frozen rules/demo labels are not automatically live-model assertions.
